guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice shows the largest anomalies (latency-90 z=+309, mem +1118% to 1.29e8, z=+223), and its callers recommendationservice and frontend degrade after it, while currencyservice and cartservice are flat. CPU (+475%), diskio and socket also rose, so mem is chosen only because it is the largest resource shift and is likely the primary fault; the others may be secondary effects, and the logs carry no errors to confirm it.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the productcatalogservice pods to release memory, then inspect heap usage and recent changes for a leak, and set memory limits and alerts. A rolling restart of replicas is non-destructive.
